name: Reservation Status 1 Code
definition: Specifies the current status of a limit.

DISA.name: Disabled
DISA.definition: Reservation is not currently in effect.|.

DELD.name: Deleted
DELD.definition: Reservation has been deleted or suspended.

REQD.name: Requested
REQD.definition: Reservation has been asked for and is not yet enabled.|.

BLKD.name: Blocked
BLKD.definition: Reservation is blocked or frozen due to external circumstances such as a court order, death of beneficiary or account owner, or bankruptcy.
